The '''TIE/x3 starfighter''' was a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] testbed created by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

==Characteristics==
It incorporated many of the design innovations from the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] and [[TIE/x2 starfighter|TIE Advanced x2]] models, including higher performance [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]] than the standard [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], improved combat software, and inward-swept solar/radiator panels configured for higher pilot visibility.

However, its hullform was more consistent with the TIE fighter, rather than the experimental departures of the TIE/x1 and TIE/x2. It also lacked those models' [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]].
